what the assessor will check on pay1: Root can't log in to this server over SSH.
Passwords are at least 14 characters long (the shop's policy, stricter than the standard's 12) and need at least one digit and one lower-case letter.
The server's own journal is kept on disk, so a reboot doesn't empty it.
rsync isn't installed or running, unless the business needs it and says so in writing.
The audit trail records sign-ins that worked and that failed, role and configuration changes, refunds, exports and card updates.
The audit trail is kept for at least 12 months (the shop's policy: 365 to 400 days).
No known vulnerability on this server is past the due date the shop's policy gives it.
